After entrusting the component materials to Hildeyerd, the supervisor begins explaining the purpose of the crafting facility. Her explanation, however, is interrupted by a young Lalafellin man, who insists on appraising the results of your apparently doomed endeavor. entries.en: You synthesize the hull interior component and show it to Tataramu. After recovering from his shock at the quality of your work, the young man demands to know the identity of your client. Upon realizing you were commissioned by a group of Ixal, however, Tataramu concludes that the beastmen mean to fashion a vessel of war, and rushes off to find the Ehcatl Nine's hidden camp. Return to Ehcatl and deliver the component to Sezul.

entries.en: No sooner have you placed the component into Sezul's hands than Tataramu bursts into the camp and accuses the chief of sullying the field of airship engineering. The Ehcatl Nine leader explains, however, that his purpose in breaking away from the Garuda-beholden Ixal was to begin construction on the Dezul Qualan─a hybrid vessel intended not to wage war, but to soar above the highest clouds. Quickly convinced by Sezul's obvious zeal and sincerity, Tataramu then begs for a position on the chief's ambitious project. Speak once more with Sezul, and decide what your own fate in this undertaking will be.

You will next be allotted a certain amount of time in which to complete the synthesis.

一定時間、施設が使用可能な状態になります。

entries.en: There was an odd rumor making the rounds amongst the engineers at the company. They say a group of Ixal had carved out a secret camp in the Black Shroud, and were conducting trials for some kind of secret weapon...
entries.fr: Hmm, maintenant que j'y pense, certains de mes collègues ingénieurs propagent des rumeurs étranges depuis quelque temps. Selon eux, une zone reculée de la forêt de Sombrelinceul abriterait des Ixali dont le but serait de développer une arme secrète...
entries.ja:
社の技術部から、奇妙な噂を聞いたことがあります。
黒衣森にて、鬱蒼とした森に隠れ、
秘密兵器の試作実験をしているイクサル族がいると……。

entries.en: I had thought it idle gossip at the time, but 'twould appear the tale held merit, after all! Your Ixali master seeks to craft an airborne vessel of war!
entries.fr: Pour être honnête, je n'ai pas vraiment accordé crédit à ces racontars, mais c'était avant de vous rencontrer... Vous vous rendez compte que ces immondes bestioles sont les ennemis jurés de Gridania ? S'ils sont vraiment en train de construire un aéronef, c'est certainement dans le but de détruire la cité !

まさかとは思っていましたが……
イクサル族といえば、グリダニアの仇敵！
それが「飛空艇」を造るとなれば、兵器に違いない！

entries.en: Isn't it obvious!? I'm going to march right into that secret camp and give those blasted birdmen a good telling off! You'd best stay out of my way!

entries.en: He's not a bad person, you know. A trifle enthusiastic about airships, but ordinarily a most straightforward and reliable fellow. And considering the location of your client, I imagine you'll be meeting him again rather soon...

entries.en: N-Never mind who I am! 'Tis you who are on trial here! Are you not the Ixali master who seeks to build a death-dealing airship and bring war and destruction to Gridania!?
